verses.en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.sm: Ua faauma e ia ana fetalaiga uma, o faalogo ai le nuu, ona maliu ai lea o ia i Kapanaumi.

verses.en: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
verses.sm: Ua mati le auauna a le tasi rara“ o le toaselau, sa faapelepeleina e ia, ua tali oti.

verses.en: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo o ia ia Iesu, ona awna mai lea e ia O toeaina o Iutaia e aioi mai ia te ia, ina ia maliu atu ma faaola lana auauna.

verses.en: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
verses.sm: Ua latou o mai ia Iesu, ona latou matuā faatoga mai lea ia te ia, ua faapea mai, “Ua aoga o ia e te fai ai le mea nei;

verses.en: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
verses.sm: aua ua alofa mai o ia i lo tatou nuu, ua na faia foi le sunako mo i matou.”

verses.en: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
verses.sm: Ona maliu atu ai lea o Iesu ma i latou; ua latalata ia i le fale, ona auina mai lea e le ta‘ita‘i o le toaselau o ana uo ia te ia, ua faapea mai ia te ia, “Le AW e, aua neʻi faalavelaveina oe; aua e lē aoga aʻu e te ulu mai ai i loʻu fale;

verses.en: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.sm: o lea foi na ou manatu ai ou te le aoga ona ou alu atu ia te oe. A ia oo mai sau fetalaiga, e faamaloloina ai lau auauna.

verses.en: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.sm: Ana o aʻu foi le tagata ua pule i ai le tasi, ua Ou pule foi i le “au tau; a aʻu fai atu i se tasi, Ina alu ia, ona alu ai lea; ma le tasi, Ina sau ia, ona sau ai lea; ma la‘u auauna, Ina faia lenei mea, ona fai ai lea.”

verses.en: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.sm: Ua faafofoga Iesu i nei mea, ona ofo ai lea ia te ia; ua faliu o ia, ma fetalai atu i le motu o tagata e ua mulimuli mai ia te ia, “Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ou te lei iloa ia Isaraelu lava se faatuatua e faapena ona tele.”

verses.en: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
verses.sm: O e na auina mai ua foi atu i le fale, ona iloa lea e i latou o le auauna ua malolo.

verses.en: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
verses.sm: Mulimuli ane ua maliu atu o ia i le aai, o Naina le igoa, ua o faatasi ma ia ona soo e toatele, ma le motu o tagata e toatele.

verses.en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.sm: Ua latalata ia i le faitotoa o le aai, faauta foi, ua fata mai le tagata oti, O le tama e toatasi o ia a lona tina, o ia foi le fafine ua on lana tane; ua ia te ia foi tagata o le aai e toa» tele.

verses.en: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.sm: Ua silasila atu le Alii ia te ia, ona mutimuti alofa lea o ia ia te ia, ua fetalai atu ia te ia, “Aua ete tagi.”

verses.en: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
verses.sm: Ua maliu ane o ia, ua pai atu i le fata; ona tutū mai ai lea o le au fata, ona fetalai atu lea o ia, “Le taulealea e, ou te fai atu ia te oe, Ina tulai ia.”

verses.en: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
verses.sm: Ona nofo ai lea i luga o le na oti, ua tautalas ona ia tuuina atu lea o ia i lona tina.

verses.en: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
verses.sm: Ua co le mataʻu ia te i latou uma, ua latou vivii atu i le Atua, ua faapea ane, “Ua tu mai ia te i tatou le perofeta sili!” i le ma lea, “Ua asiasi mai le Atua i lona nuu!”

verses.en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
verses.sm: Ua soo lava lutaia uma ma le itu uma i lenei tala ia te ia.

verses.en: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
verses.sm: Ua faailoa atu ia loane ne: mea uma E ona soo.

verses.en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.sm: Ona valaau atu lea e loane i ona soo se toalua, ua aauina atu i laua ia Iesu, ua faapea ane, “Po o oe ea lē maliu mai, pe matou te faatali atu i se tasi?”

verses.en: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.sm: Ua o mai ia tagata ia te ia, ua faapea mai, “Ua aauina mai i maua e loane le papatiso ia te oe, ua fai mai, Po o oe ea lé maliu mai, pe matou te faatali atu i se tasi?”

verses.en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
verses.sm: O lea lava itu aso ua faamalolo ai e ia tagata e toatele sa iai tak, ta tak tiga, ma agaga leaga; ua foai atu foi ina ia vaai o e tauaso e toatele.

verses.en: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o ia ia te i laua, ua faapea atu, “Ina o atu ia oulua, ma faailoa atu ia loane o mea ua oulua vaai i ai, ma faalogo i ai; ua pupula tauaso, ua savavali pipili, ua faamamáina lepela, ua logo tutuli, ua faatutúina e na oti, ua folafolaina le tala lelei i e matitiva.

verses.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.sm: E manuia foi se le tausuai ia te au.”

verses.en: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.sm: Ua oe na awna mai e Ioane, ona amata ai lea o ia ona fetalai atu i le motu o tagata e uiga ia Ioane, “Na outou o i le vao e matamata i ni a? Ole u ea ua luluina e le matagi?

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
verses.sm: Pe na outou o e matamata i ni a? O le tagata ea ua ofu i ofu malúlú? Faauta, o e ofu i ofu matagofie, ma ua solo lelei, o i maota o tupu ia.

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.sm: Pe na owon o e matamata i ni a? O le perofeta ea? E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, E sili lava ia i le perofeta.

verses.en: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.sm: O ia lea ua tusi mai i ai, Faauta, ou te auina atu la‘u sávali i ou luma, na te teuteua lou ala i ou luma.

verses.en: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu foi ia te outou, E leai se perofeta i e na fananau i fafine, e sili ia Ioane le papatiso; a o lé aupito itiiti i le malo o le Atua, e sili lea ia te ia.”

verses.en: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
verses.sm: Ona ta‘uamiotonuina ai lea o le Atua e le nuu uma lava e na faalogo ai, atoa ma tagata ao lafoga ina ua papatisoina i latou i le papatisoga a Ioane.

verses.en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
verses.sm: A o le au faresaio ma le au aʻoaʻo tulafono, ua latou faaleaoga ia te i latou le pule a le Atua, ina ua le papatisoina i latou e ia.

verses.en: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
verses.sm: “Ou te faatusa i ni a tagata o lenei tupulaga, latou te tusa ma ni a?

verses.en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
verses.sm: E tusa ia ma tamaiti ua nonofo i le malae, ma fevalaauai, ua faapea ane, Ua matou faaili atu ia te outou, a e tou te lei saasaa mai; ua matou fetagisi atu ia te outou, a e tou te lei taufaitagituʻi mai.

verses.en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
verses.sm: Auā na sau Ioane le papatiso, ua le “ai areto, ua le inu uaina foi, ona outou fai ane lea, Ua ia te ia le temoni.

verses.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
verses.sm: Ua sau le Atalii o le tagata, ua ‘ai o ia ma inu; ona outou fai ane lea, Faauta, o le tagata “ai tele ta le inu uaina, o le uo a tagata ao lafoga ma e agasala.

verses.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
verses.sm: A ua tatuamiotonuina le poto e ana tama uma.”

verses.en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le tasi o le au faresaio se'i la aai ma ia; ua maliu atu ia i le fale o le faresaio, ona taoto ai lea o ia e taumafa.

verses.en: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
verses.sm: Faauta foi, o le fafine o le aai, o ia o le IOI fafine agasala, ua iloa e ja ua taoto o ia e taumafa i le fale o le faresaio, ona au mai lea e ja o le fagu alapasa ua tumu i le ;uauu manogi;

verses.en: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.sm: ua faauu e ia i oʻu vae i le suauu manogi. O lea foi oute fai atuai ia te oe, Ua faamagaloina ana agasala e tele, aua ua alofa tele mai o ia; tu foi o ia i tua i ona vae, ua tagi, uaja o le ua faamagaloina i ai se mea faasisina ifo e ia loimata i ona vae, ua 50101 ai i lona lava lauulu, ua sogi foi i ona vae, ma faauuina i le suauu manogi.

verses.en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le faresaio na fai atu ia te ia, ona faapea ifo ai lea o ia i lona loto, “Ana se perofeta lenei, po ua iloa e ia lenei fafine, ma lana amio, ua ia pa“ atu ia te ca; ana o le fafine agasala ia.”

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu ai lea o Iesu ia te ia, “Simona e, o lau upu ou te fai atu ia te ce.” Ua fai mai o ia, “Le aʻoaʻo e, fetalai mai ia.”

verses.en: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
verses.sm: “O tagata e toalua sa la nonò mai tupe i le tagata e toatasi; sa nonó mai le tasi i tenari e lima selau, e a le tasi e limagafulu.

verses.en: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
verses.sm: Ua leai ni a la tupe e toe avatu, ona faamagalo fua lea o ia ia te i laua uma. Ina fai mai ia, po o ai so laua e tele lena alofa ia te ia?”

verses.en: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
verses.sm: Ua tali mai Simona, “Ai lava o lea na faamagaloina atu ana meae tele.” Ua fetalai atu o ia ia te ia, “Ua tonu lau taofi.”

verses.en: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
verses.sm: Ona faliu atu lea o ia i le fafine, ua fetalai atu ia Simona, “Ua e iloa ea le fafine nei? Na ou ulu mai i lou fale, e te lei au mai ni vai mo oʻu vae; peitai O ia, ua faasisina ifo e ia o loimata i oʻu vae, ma sõloi ai i lona lava lauulu.

verses.en: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.sm: E te lei feasogi mai ia te au; peitai o ia, ua le aunoa ona sogi i oʻu vae talu lava ona ulufale mai o ia.

verses.en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.sm: E te lei faauu mai i lo‘u ulu i le suāuu fua;

verses.en: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
verses.sm: peitai o ia, ua itiiti, ua itiiti foi lona alofa.”

verses.en: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu o ia i le fafine, “Ua faamagaloina au agasala.”

verses.en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
verses.sm: O e na taooto e aai ua amata ona faapea ifo i o latou loto, “O ai foi lenei o le faamagaloina agasala?”

verses.en: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu o ia i le fafine, “O lou faatuatua ua faaolaina ai oe; ina alu ia oe ma le manuia.”
